summary:
Paramount+ is the streaming service at paramountplus.com. The mountain-and-plus tab icon is what that host serves, distinct from the CBS or Paramount Pictures corporate sites.

Checked 12 November 2026 against paramountplus.com. HTML came from https://www.paramountplus.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.paramountplus.com/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.paramountplus.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 101524 bytes. Directory sizes: 256×256, 128×128, 64×64, 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #0066ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-256x256-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 1830 bytes) from https://www.paramountplus.com/favicon.ico.
